newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end firm in technically driven trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end firm in technically driven trade.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed higher in a technical bounce, but prices are seen working lower in the near term, market sources said.
"We were a bit oversold and came up, but there is no great momentum so we might develop a lower range until we pick up some momentum," said Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter.
Open interest in May rose 664 lots to 13,364 lots.
On the fundamental side, the market awaits Friday's USDA Florida crop estimate. Trading sources expect USDA to raise yields slightly.
The estimate for Brazil's crop will be released May 20. In the meantime, technicals are expected to dominate trade.
Spot May closed 0.35 cent higher at 74.90 cents a lb after trading from 76.00 to 74.55 cents. Second-position July ended 0.65 firmer at 78.10 cents.
Volume was estimated at 2,000 lots against Friday's official tally of 4,836 lots.
